decisions.summary: The margin's choice, the canvas's room and the belt keep HOMESTEAD_GROUND_FT's 104; maps do not start larger
decisions.why: Unchanged since round 2. The GM's larger-maps line is conditional in its own words ('If the thing that is stopping us ... is the margin in the sense of being the edge of the map'); R12 measured the condition false (the canvas grown alone made 40 households worse) and growing canvas, margin and belt refused sites the base seated (R11), which FR-008 forbids. Implied by the GM's own condition, not by cost.

decisions.summary: D1's FR-011 verdict GO from R15's band-alone leg, back to back with the base: 427.7 -> 95.0 s over the fifteen seeds the base rolled (100.0 over all sixteen), first margin on 9 of 16
decisions.why: R15 runs base, the band with DRY_SPELL/RESCUE_SHORT disabled, and the band with both, one after the other; a verdict on its own leg is FR-011 as written. Round 3's two figure corrections are made and re-derived from legs.log: base 427.65 s over 15 seeds; band 95.04 s over the same 15 (100.04 over 16, seed 7 at 5.00); rung=1 on 9 of 16 (11 of 16 with both); 427.7/95.0 = 4.5x.

decisions.summary: Rescue and dry-spell cap built on R15's third leg on the final D1 (100.0 -> 83.3 s, margins saved on seeds 25, 8 and 6, no seed seating fewer); since round 4 the rescue runs only on a margin one to three short and gives up after 600 dry offers (R17)
decisions.why: Round 5: the added sentence is a defect fix inside the built lever, and it carries FR-011's terms on its own measurement - R17 (one-shot labeled: 2026-10-02, the perf-audit's three alternated rounds) has fifteen seeds with identical offers, margins and houses and seed 39 15.10 -> 9.29 s with all 40 seated, so faster beyond the spread and every household seated; FR-008 holds. The code at de6c9759a matches the sentence (0 < want - placed <= RESCUE_SHORT = 3; RESCUE_DRY_SPELL = 600 on the rescue's offer_seats). The cap narrows nothing the GM asked: no household is given up (every successful rescue took its houses by offer 512) and it serves the request's purpose of not spending seconds per house. FR-006 (the census) is untouched by it. R15's original GO stands as stated.

decisions.summary: FR-003 and FR-004 not built (R1, R3, R4 NO-GO; FR-003's rules-based form argued, not prototyped); seed 47 restated from R15; misses recorded and raised
decisions.why: FR-011 builds no lever without its own GO and FR-002's further rounds were run. Round 2's note is fixed: seed 47 at 2.99 s alone and 3.11 s with D2, first margin, matches legs.log.
